listings.thesis: Inductor and MLCC leverage with rising AI server density; bottleneck, AI-adjacent, 2026-catalyst, central-node.
listings.revisionNote: On a crowding-sensitive alpha list, a +20% single-day spike with no identifiable new fundamental news - on top of +389% YTD and a price now ~2.5x above freshly hiked sell-side targets - is a textbook post-rerating chase; residual alpha shrinks further even though the bottleneck thesis is intact.

priorCase.rankRationale: Passives-alpha lens: new evidence (June 17 AI-server MLCC capacity build, GS structural-deficit-to-2030 framing) genuinely strengthens the inductor/MLCC bottleneck thesis. But at +361% YTD on a crowding-sensitive 'rerated benchmark' list the residual alpha is thin. Small +1, hold rank.
